annotations.title: Check a claim against DFX's evidence

description: SUPPORTED, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED or UNKNOWN for a claim, with the observations. Give a sentence ('Family Office X invested in Company Y in 2025', 'Z is a family office') or a structured subject / predicate / object / year. DFX contradicts only what its own record contradicts; absence of evidence is UNKNOWN, never CONTRADICTED. Its predicates cover investment, acquisition, co-investment, employment and identity claims; property facts are outside them.
